Good to know

How long does delivery take?

3-7 working days across India. Free shipping above ₹999.

What is the return policy?

7-day easy returns on unworn items with tags.

Do you offer cash on delivery?

Yes, COD, UPI and cards are all accepted.

How do I pick my size?

Our fits are oversized. Take your usual size for a relaxed look, or size down for a regular fit.
